author: Aubie (auto-proposed)

lesson.title: Wonder as Discovery Tool
lesson.topic: How cultivating genuine curiosity and wonder can enhance learning and discovery in various fields, from science to philosophy.
lesson.steelman: In what ways does the practice of wonder improve one's ability to ask insightful questions that lead to new discoveries?
lesson.example: The story of Galileo using his sense of wonder about the heavens to question established beliefs and pioneer observational astronomy.

rationale: This lesson highlights how wonder is not just an emotion but a powerful cognitive tool for advancing knowledge.
